name: JGRAFT namespaces
desc: JGRAFT construction, metadata and version rejection, sequential constants, nested constant/stash scopes, action-local TEMP, current-node rebinding, and reference expressions NODE, CONST, STASH, and TEMP. Paths cover literal and computed selectors, one-level expansion, numeric names, missing values, write restrictions, literal-pattern behavior, and independent snapshots. CAP is checked only as an empty read-only namespace. No macros or named captures are exercised. Unsupported-version cases assume the implementation does not support the unpublished integer versions used here. Structural validation follows the current INVALID_GRAFT rules, not the old INVALID_TARGET/INVALID_OPERAND distinction. Where strict is absent, the listed lazy expectations also apply to full local validation.
